text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a fresh fruit plate with watermelon, strawberries, raspberries, a blackberry, blueberries, cantaloupe and pineapple chunks.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a square white dinner-size plate, about 24–26 cm across. I treated it as roughly equivalent to a 26 cm plate: area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Watermelon chunks, strawberries (halves and whole), raspberries, blackberry, blueberries, cantaloupe pieces and pineapple chunks. No dressing or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area (food covers about 50% of the plate):**

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Watermelon | 20% | 106 cm² |
| Strawberries | 7% | 37 cm² |
| Raspberries | 3% | 16 cm² |
| Blackberry | 2% | 11 cm² |
| Blueberries | 3% | 16 cm² |
| Cantaloupe | 7% | 37 cm² |
| Pineapple | 8% | 42 cm² |
| **Total** | **50%** | |

**STEP 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Volume | Density | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Watermelon | 106 × 2.5 = 265 ml | 0.6 | 159 g | 30 | 48 |
| Strawberries | 37 × 2.5 = 93 ml | 0.6 | 56 g | 32 | 18 |
| Raspberries | 16 × 2 = 32 ml | 0.5 | 16 g | 52 | 8 |
| Blackberry | 11 × 2 = 22 ml | 0.5 | 11 g | 43 | 5 |
| Blueberries | 16 × 1.2 = 19 ml | 0.6 | 11 g | 57 | 6 |
| Cantaloupe | 37 × 2 = 74 ml | 0.6 | 44 g | 34 | 15 |
| Pineapple | 42 × 2 = 84 ml | 0.6 | 50 g | 50 | 25 |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 347 g and 125 kcal. That is plausible for a generous half-covered fruit plate.
